Hi Lena —

Thanks for sending these over and for the target timeline. A few quick items from our side:

1) Preferred evidence: we accept either a bank letter (as you provided) + signed W-9, or micro-deposits. If possible, please attach a signed W-9 to the thread — that will speed up our verification.

2) Remittance mapping: our finance system matches payments to invoices by PO number first, then by the invoice field "Remit Reference". For Hartwell, please include the PO (e.g., PO-12345) in the Remit Reference column of your CSV and on the invoice PDF if possible. The sample CSV you sent helps, but we need the column header to be exactly "RemitReference" (no spaces) to auto-map.

3) Wire vs ACH: For larger one-off transfers we use wire routing (SWIFT), but our default disbursements will attempt ACH first. If the ACH fails, we may retry as a wire. Please confirm whether the account accepts both.

I'll attach our vendor onboarding form for completion — it includes the internal vendor code field which our AP team requires. Marissa, Rishi: looping you in to confirm the micro-deposit approach vs bank-letter-only for HW-4761.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
--
